components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single strongest in-flow action, such as Approve or Save.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; min-height:28px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:0 10px; border:1px solid var(--ink, #16181b); border-radius:5px; background:var(--ink, #16181b); color:var(--paper, #f7f7f5); font:500 11px/1 'Schibsted Grotesk','PingFang SC',sans-serif; white-space:nowrap; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#30343a; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent, #c8442e); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Neutral action that needs a visible edge, such as Deny or Inspect.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; min-height:28px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:0 10px; border:1px solid var(--line-strong, #c9c9c1); border-radius:5px; background:var(--surface, #fff); color:var(--ink, #16181b); font:500 11px/1 'Schibsted Grotesk','PingFang SC',sans-serif; white-space:nowrap; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 140ms ease,border-color 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color:#b6b6ad; background:var(--paper-raised, #fbfbf8); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent, #c8442e); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Tertiary action that stays invisible until hover or focus.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { display:inline-flex; min-height:28px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:0 10px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:5px; background:transparent; color:var(--muted, #555a61); font:500 11px/1 'Schibsted Grotesk','PingFang SC',sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 140ms ease,color 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { background:var(--hover, #ecece6); color:var(--ink, #16181b); } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent, #c8442e); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Composer
components.description: The chat-first input with attachment, context, model, and send controls.
components.html:
问 Hermes，或键入 / 和 @…
+@/Opus 4.5 · High
components.css: .ds-composer { width:100%; padding:8px 9px 7px; border:1px solid var(--line-strong, #c9c9c1); border-radius:9px; background:var(--surface, #fff); box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(22 24 27 / 5%); font:400 13.5px/1.58 'Schibsted Grotesk','PingFang SC',sans-serif; color:var(--faint, #676c73); } .ds-composer-line { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; min-height:32px; } .ds-send { width:26px; height:26px; border:0; border-radius:50%; background:var(--ink, #16181b); color:var(--paper, #f7f7f5); font:500 15px/1 sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-send:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent, #c8442e); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-composer-meta { display:flex; gap:10px; padding-top:6px; color:var(--muted, #555a61); font:500 9px/1 'Spline Sans Mono',monospace; }

components.name: Route String
components.description: The signature execution-context strip: origin, gateway, profile, transport.
components.html: YOUHOMELABSSH@research
components.css: .ds-route { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; min-height:28px; padding:6px 9px; border:1px solid var(--line, #e2e2db); border-radius:5px; background:var(--paper, #f7f7f5); color:var(--ink, #16181b); font:500 8.5px/1.4 'Spline Sans Mono',monospace; letter-spacing:.04em; } .ds-route b { font-weight:600; } .ds-route span { color:var(--muted, #555a61); } .ds-route .ds-route-origin { color:var(--ink, #16181b); } .ds-route .ds-route-transport { padding:2px 4px; border:1px solid var(--line-strong, #c9c9c1); border-radius:2px; color:var(--muted, #555a61); font-size:7px; } .ds-route svg { width:26px; height:8px; flex:0 0 26px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Uppercase short status with a dot and a word; color is never the only signal.
components.css: .ds-status { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:5px; min-height:20px; padding:2px 6px; border:1px solid var(--line, #e2e2db); border-radius:3px; background:var(--paper-deep, #f1f1ed); color:var(--ink-soft, #30343a); font:500 8.5px/1.4 'Spline Sans Mono',monospace; letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-status i { width:5px; height:5px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--ok, #376d4a); box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #eef6ef; }

components.name: Toggle Switch
components.description: Small state switch used for Skills, Channels, and preferences.
components.css: .ds-switch { position:relative; width:28px; height:16px; padding:0; border:0; border-radius:999px; background:var(--line-strong, #c9c9c1); cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-switch span { position:absolute; top:2px; left:2px; width:12px; height:12px; border-radius:50%; background:#fff; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(22 24 27 / 20%); transition:transform 160ms ease; } .ds-switch.is-on { background:var(--ink, #16181b); } .ds-switch.is-on span { transform:translateX(12px); } .ds-switch:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent, #c8442e); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Gateway Row
components.description: A single connection in the switcher or registry, with transport, health, and latency.
components.css: .ds-gateway { display:flex; width:100%; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:8px 10px; border:1px solid var(--line, #e2e2db); border-radius:5px; background:var(--paper-raised, #fbfbf8); color:var(--ink, #16181b); text-align:left; cursor:pointer; } .ds-gateway:hover { border-color:var(--line-strong, #c9c9c1); background:#f7f7f4; } .ds-gateway:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent, #c8442e); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-gateway-mark { display:grid; place-items:center; width:22px; height:22px; border:1px solid var(--line-strong, #c9c9c1); border-radius:3px; font:500 8px/1 'Spline Sans Mono',monospace; } .ds-gateway-copy { display:grid; flex:1; gap:2px; min-width:0; } .ds-gateway-copy b { font:600 11px/1.2 'Schibsted Grotesk','PingFang SC',sans-serif; } .ds-gateway-copy em { color:var(--faint, #676c73); font:400 7px/1.4 'Spline Sans Mono',monospace; font-style:normal; } .ds-gateway-copy span { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:4px; color:var(--muted, #555a61); font:400 7px/1.4 'Spline Sans Mono',monospace; } .ds-gateway-copy i { width:5px; height:5px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--ok, #376d4a); } .ds-gateway-check { color:var(--faint, #676c73); font:600 10px/1 sans-serif; }

components.name: Command Palette Row
components.description: One keyboard-selectable command in the ⌘K palette.
components.css: .ds-palette-row { display:flex; width:100%; align-items:center; gap:9px; padding:8px 9px; border:0; border-radius:3px; background:transparent; color:var(--ink, #16181b); text-align:left; cursor:pointer; } .ds-palette-row:hover,.ds-palette-row.is-selected { background:var(--paper-deep, #f1f1ed); } .ds-palette-row:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent, #c8442e); outline-offset:0; } .ds-palette-icon { display:grid; place-items:center; width:22px; height:22px; border:1px solid var(--line, #e2e2db); border-radius:3px; background:var(--surface, #fff); color:var(--muted, #555a61); font:500 10px/1 'Spline Sans Mono',monospace; } .ds-palette-row > span:nth-child(2) { display:grid; flex:1; gap:2px; } .ds-palette-row b { font:500 10.5px/1.3 'Schibsted Grotesk','PingFang SC',sans-serif; } .ds-palette-row em { color:var(--faint, #676c73); font:400 8px/1.4 'Spline Sans Mono',monospace; font-style:normal; } .ds-palette-enter { color:var(--faint, #676c73); font:500 10px/1 'Spline Sans Mono',monospace; }

narrative.overview: Hermes Desktop is a paper-and-ink operating surface for work that moves between machines. The conversation is the page; everything else waits in the margins. A persistent route string carries execution context as a path, not a badge, so the user can read where the next command will land without scanning a dashboard. The visual world borrows from postal routing slips, dispatch dockets, and technical documentation: thin rules, small measured labels, circled handoff marks, and one postal vermilion accent reserved for the active leg, focus, and the destructive threshold.
keyCharacteristics: Paper-white field, near-black ink, and a single vermilion routing accent.
A 720px conversation column that stays visually still while scope changes.
Hairline structure, small radii, and almost no resting shadow.
Technical labels set in Spline Sans Mono, but never as decoration.
Local versus remote context readable in text at every width.

rules.name: The Postal Red Rule
rules.body: Vermilion occupies less than ten percent of any screen. If it starts filling surfaces, the route has stopped being a signal.

rules.name: The Heading Stands Alone Rule
rules.body: No kicker or eyebrow above a heading. Context belongs in a neighbouring control, a status line, or the heading's own words.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: If a surface stays in the document flow, it uses a border or a tonal step, never a shadow. Shadows are reserved for overlays.

rules.name: The Measurement Rule
rules.body: Monospace is for code, paths, model names, counts, and latency. It never carries a marketing sentence.

dos: Do keep the conversation column at 720px and let secondary capability overlay or hide.
Do repeat execution context in the route string, composer scope line, and status bar.
Do use postal vermilion for routing, focus, and destructive thresholds only.
Do pair every status color with a word, icon, or measured value.
Do preserve terminal scrollback and preview state when the workspace is hidden.
Do write Chinese UI copy with English Hermes terms kept intact.
donts: Don't place a kicker or eyebrow above a heading.
Don't turn the gateway list into a permanent fleet dashboard on the resting screen.
Don't use a one-sided colored bar as a status device.
Don't use gradient text, glass decoration, or a zero-offset colored halo as depth.
Don't use monospace for prose or pack technical labels into every row.
Don't imply that simulated latency, SSH, Cloud, Telegram, or voice input is live.
